OPS-REVIEW-01.contract: beginAttempt exclusively reserves the task before startProcess; no second reservation until the previous attempt completes.

OPS-REVIEW-02.contract: Retries require a result, stopped true, and completed assessment when required.

OPS-REVIEW-A1.contract: Persisted assessmentRequired:true blocks concurrent finalize until every process is assessed; the real CLI enables it.

limitations: At-most-once local final claim is not remote exactly-once delivery. A consumer crash after claim requires manual reconciliation.
A crashed lock owner fails closed; inspect and manually recover the campaign-local lock.
Service verification covers Linux owned process groups, not processes deliberately escaping with setsid.
Atomic local state survives process restart; no claim of power-loss fsync durability.
A reservation whose owner crashes before startProcess remains fail-closed and requires manual inspection.
Raw-command campaigns default to assessmentRequired:false; suite consumers must explicitly enable the persisted contract.
OPS-REVIEW-A2 concerns the gift guide browser test and is outside this OPS-only change scope.
